summary: The figure shows a world map illustrating under-five mortality rates by country using color shading and neonatal mortality rates using circle sizes and colors. The highest under-five mortality rates (>75 per 1000 live births) are concentrated in many African countries, with lower rates in the Americas, Europe, and parts of Asia. Neonatal mortality rates are represented by red and green circles of varying sizes, with the largest circles mostly in African countries, indicating higher neonatal mortality. Some regions have no data or are marked as not applicable.
